emily.peopleops: Hi team — urgent. Employee lost physical insurance card and their specialty pharmacy (OncoScripts) filled a chemo-support med but billed it OON. Claim 22-SP-998 denied for OON. Member has active Redwood Core PPO and prior auth PA-3314 for supportive therapy. Need: 1) temporary digital ID so pharmacy can confirm coverage and refill today, 2) guidance to get claim reprocessed in-network (pharmacy says their billing entity/TIN didn't match).

ryan.benefits: Yikes. Two paths: temp ID for scheduling/refill and appeals for the claim. We can issue a proof-of-coverage/temporary ID showing member name, member ID, group #, plan name, and note that it's not a payment guarantee. That usually lets pharmacy proceed.

claire.hr: Can benefits also pre-fill suggested language for the pharmacy resubmission? They keep saying the billing TIN is different from insurer provider file. Member is mid-cycle and needs meds tonight.

pharmacy-liason: Pharmacies often bill under the specialty distributor TIN; insurer's provider file may have a different NPI/TIN mapping. OncoScripts should resubmit using their contracted provider NPI and include PA-3314 in the claim remarks. If they can't, we can ask insurer to reprocess showing the prior auth covers the drug.

ryan.benefits: Suggested resubmission text for the pharmacy: "Please reprocess claim 22-SP-998 and apply Prior Authorization PA-3314. Correct billing provider NPI/TIN to contracted entity on provider file. Denial due to provider credential mismatch. Attach PA documentation and itemized invoice." Have them populate claim remark box with PA-3314 and set code for "reconsideration/reprocessing."

emily.peopleops: @insurer-bot can you generate the temp digital ID and a one-line proof-of-coverage we can email to the pharmacy? Also include insurer claims phone and portal link.

insurer-bot: Draft temporary ID/proof-of-coverage: "Redwood Inference — Temporary Proof of Coverage (informational only). Member: [NAME]. Member ID: [MASKED_ID]. Group: RED-502. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Coverage dates: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior authorization on file: PA-3314. For claim inquiries call insurer provider relations 1-800-555-0199 or submit provider portal case at provider.insurer.example.com. This document does not guarantee payment."

claire.hr: That works. Add a line advising pharmacy to confirm the rendering provider NPI/TIN before final billing. That prevents repeat denials.

insurer-bot: Updated line added: "Please confirm the billing provider NPI/TIN matches insurer provider file prior to submission."

emily.peopleops: I'll DM the member the temp ID and send the email template for OncoScripts with the resubmission language. Ryan — can you open an insurer escalation once the pharmacy confirms resubmission? We'll attach PA-3314 and the EOB.

ryan.benefits: Yep. I'll file escalation referencing claim 22-SP-998 and PA-3314. If insurer resists, escalate to medical appeals with prescription history and oncologist note. Keep all receipts and the NDC/HCPCS codes for the drug.

pharmacy-liason: One more note for the member: if the pharmacy still refuses to fill without a card, the member can show the temp PDF and provide the insurer phone; they can also pay out-of-pocket and submit for reimbursement — but push the pharmacy to resubmit in-network first.

emily.peopleops: Thank you all. I'll follow up after the pharmacy responds. :pray:
